functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: 'Lat dorsi's little helper' -- shares the same insertion groove and internal-rotator/adductor/extensor action.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: insertion (crest of the lesser tubercle of the humerus)
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Given by Yi et al. as the middle 20% of the muscle from origin to insertion.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the posterior thoracic wall 2-3 cm distal to the posterior axillary fold, with the shoulder held adducted and internally rotated.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial to the rib cortex and intercostal muscles.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Three masses appear medial to lateral: subscapularis, teres major, latissimus dorsi.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Injected with pectoralis major and subscapularis for the internally rotated, adducted shoulder, and with latissimus dorsi for the extended one. Also used for hemiplegic shoulder pain, where the deep pair (teres major, subscapularis) is injected alongside the superficial pair (pectoralis major, latissimus dorsi).
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part II -- Proximal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(6):276 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17060276 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Yi, Li, Yang, Moon and others)

trigger_points.location_description: Medial trigger point near the inferior-angle origin of the muscle
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Posterior deltoid region and over the long head of triceps; occasionally to the dorsal forearm; rarely to the scapular area.
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Sharp with reaching up-and-forward (driving, serving); limited end-range elevation (hand-up-the-back and full overhead reach both pull on it).
trigger_points.notes: The most frequent latent trigger-point muscle in chronic shoulder pain (49% of patients).
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded shoulder muscle reference document (Donnelly JM, Fernandez-de-las-Penas C, Finnegan M, Freeman JL (eds), Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, 3rd ed., Wolters Kluwer, 2019)

trigger_points.location_description: Lateral trigger point in the posterior axillary fold near the humeral insertion, pincer-palpated
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Posterior deltoid region and over the long head of triceps; occasionally to the dorsal forearm; rarely to the scapular area.
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Sharp with reaching up-and-forward (driving, serving); limited end-range elevation (hand-up-the-back and full overhead reach both pull on it).
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded shoulder muscle reference document (Donnelly JM, Fernandez-de-las-Penas C, Finnegan M, Freeman JL (eds), Myofascial Pain and Dysfunction: The Trigger Point Manual, 3rd ed., Wolters Kluwer, 2019)
